en_title: Everything Coming to Cyberpunk 2077 With the 2.5 Update, Including New Side Quests, New Double Trouble Perk, and Much More
cn_title: 《赛博朋克2077》2.5更新加入多项新内容
subtitle: 夜之城再添新玩法
opus_summary: CD Projekt公布《赛博朋克2077》2.5更新内容，加入《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》联动任务、装备与电台。更新还带来新专长、义体外观自定义、跨平台模组支持、主机视野调节及DLSS 4.5支持。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has revealed what to expect from the Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 update, which ties in with the release of Netflix anime Edgerunners 2 .
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt公布《赛博朋克2077》2.5更新内容。本次更新将与Netflix动画《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》联动。

paragraphs.en: Edgerunners content includes a new side quest called Clampdown, which is set before the events of Edgerunners 2 ( CD Projekt recently confirmed that Edgerunners 2 is set in 2078 , just one year after the game itself). During this quest you’ll get a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King from Season 2. There’s also a new radio station that has tracks from the Edgerunners series.
paragraphs.cn: 联动内容包括名为Clampdown的新支线任务，故事发生在《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》剧情之前。CD Projekt最近确认，该动画故事设定于2078年，也就是游戏剧情发生的一年后。完成任务后，玩家可以获得一套以第二季角色King为原型的五件套装备。此外，游戏还会新增一个收录《赛博朋克：边缘行者》系列曲目的电台。

paragraphs.en: But there’s plenty more coming with 2.5 unrelated to Edgerunners, including more side quests. The Welcome to Paradise! side quest takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night, the founder of Night City itself. There’s also a new side quest that acts as an extension of Fool on the Hill, which includes new tarot cards.
paragraphs.cn: 2.5更新还有许多与《赛博朋克：边缘行者》无关的新内容，其中也包括更多支线任务。《Welcome to Paradise!》将带玩家踏上解谜之旅，并跟随由夜之城创始人Richard Night讲述的导览探索夜之城。另有一项新支线延续了《Fool on the Hill》的内容，并加入新的塔罗牌。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, 2.5 lets you customize your hand cyberware, which will let you give your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System implants a new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.
paragraphs.cn: 2.5还允许玩家自定义手臂义体外观，为螳螂刀、猩猩手臂、单分子线或发射系统植入体换上新造型。每位Glamdoc都在一家独特的商店中提供服务，并拥有配有配音和动画的专属开场场景；店内还有各具特色的义体外观目录，颜色也可以自定义。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the most significant addition with 2.5 is the new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree, which lets you dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category for the first time. The hope is that the perk will enable an entirely new playstyle, and I’m sure fans will get a kick out of trying it out.
paragraphs.cn: 2.5最重要的新内容或许是冷静属性树中的Double Trouble专长。玩家首次可以双持强能类手枪和左轮手枪。开发团队希望这项专长能带来全新的玩法，相信玩家也会乐于尝试。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, there’s cross-platform mod support on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X and S, and various quality-of-life improvements, such as saves in the “Load Game” menu grouped by separate playthroughs, and, finally, an FOV (Field Of View) slider on consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，PC、Mac、PS5、PS5 Pro和XBOX Series版本将支持跨平台模组。更新还会带来多项便利性改进，例如「载入游戏」菜单会按不同周目整理存档，主机版也终于加入视野范围滑块。

paragraphs.en: On the tech side of things, there’s support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model, and various performance improvements.
paragraphs.cn: 技术方面，游戏将支持DLSS 4.5，包括最高6倍多帧生成或动态多帧生成，以及第二代Transformer模型；更新还会带来多项性能优化。

paragraphs.en: Overall, 2.5 is a welcome surprise for Cyberpunk 2077, after CD Projekt had indicated it had no plans for further DLC for the hugely successful game. Of course, The Witcher 3 is getting a new expansion 12 years after launch, so perhaps CD Projekt will return later on with a new expansion for Cyberpunk 2077. For now, though, 2.5 is sure to spark a return to Night City for lapsed players, and give fans of Edgerunners a push to jump in if they haven’t already.
paragraphs.cn: 总的来说，2.5更新为《赛博朋克2077》带来了惊喜，此前CD Projekt曾表示没有继续为这款大获成功的游戏推出DLC的计划。《巫师3》将在发售12年后迎来新扩展包，因此CD Projekt或许将来也会为《赛博朋克2077》推出扩展内容。不过眼下，2.5更新肯定会吸引一度离开游戏的玩家重返夜之城，也会推动《赛博朋克：边缘行者》的粉丝入坑。
